design: 12 independently switchable trains, 110 pressure vessels per train, 7 elements per vessel (the project's calibrated 8-inch seawater element, 41 m2), single stage, single pass, 40% recovery; physics model supplies q and power
power_component_scope: exact physics model electricity components; feed25C constant; outdoor air temperature only affects PV source output
forecast: previous observed 24h PV pattern, no future actual PV input; optionally 40% upward bias stress
capacity_disturbance: prescribed accepted-production yield becomes0.9 fromhour24, electrical draw unchanged; a sensitivity stress, not a fitted fouling law
comparison: equal demand, same hardware, same initial and target terminal stock; failed stock/service cases excluded from saving claims
quality: all physics dispatch points must meet modeled TDS500mg/L screen plus physics feasibility; not a drinking-water certificate
startup_note: 5minute routine restart diversion and2hmin-on are study assumptions. No post-CIPrestart or chemical cleaningprotocol is simulated.
bigplant_note: Demand = 8 trains (88,000 m3/day); capacity 12 trains = 1.5 x demand; tank 12 h of demand; PV 0.8 kWp per m3/day of demand. Stress cases scaled by the same ratios. Steady policy fixed_eight_trains replaces fixed_two_trains.
